nodes.description: address internal owner; set from tx.origin in constructor, gates delegate() and list().
address internal protectionFromBots; external contract invoked by the checkBots modifier and by list().
address public uniPair; address of the computed Uniswap/Pancake pair used as argument to the bot protection call.
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; token ledger mutated by transferFrom and by list() with raw unchecked arithmetic.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; decremented in transferFrom without SafeMath and set to uint(-1) for uniRouter/uniPair in constructor.
uint public totalSupply = 1e26; used in list() to mint 6% of supply to msg.sender.
IUniswapV2Router02 public uniRouter; hardcoded router address granted unlimited allowance.
address public wBNB; wrapped native token address used as one leg of the pair computation.
Ionx constructor: sets owner = tx.origin, computes uniPair, and grants unlimited allowances to router and pair.
transfer(address,uint) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable with checkBots modifier; mutates allowance and balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic and makes an external call before state updates.
approve(address,uint) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-value protection (approve race).
delegate(address,bytes) public payable; owner-only wrapper around an arbitrary delegatecall.
list(uint,address[],uint[]) public payable; owner-only liquidity setup that overwrites balances, calls addLiquidityETH and protectionFromBots, then rewrites arbitrary balances in a loop.
checkBots(address,address,uint) modifier; performs a low-level external call to protectionFromBots and requires the returned boolean before continuing.
pairForPancake(address,address) internal pure; deterministically derives the pair address from CREATE2 hashing.
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used for allowance checks, approve and owner authorization.
tx.origin; attacker-influenceable origin used to assign owner and to seed unlimited allowances.
block.timestamp; miner-manipulable value used to build the router deadline in list().
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(); executes arbitrary attacker-supplied code in the token's storage context if owner is compromised.
protectionFromBots.call(...) inside checkBots modifier; low-level call with attacker-influenceable target executed before any state update of transferFrom.
uniRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...) with block.timestamp-derived deadline; external call with ETH forwarding.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; raw unchecked subtraction under Solidity ^0.7.0.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value; raw unchecked subtraction of untrusted amount.
balanceOf[_to] += _value; raw unchecked addition that can wrap around the uint supply.
protectionFromBots.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0xd5eaf4c3, _reallyGoHere)) in list(); ignored return value and external control transfer before balance writes.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the spender branch and allowance debit inside transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], caller identity is the authorization key.
owner is assigned tx.origin in the constructor, so ownership derives from an attacker-influenceable origin rather than msg.sender.
list() builds the router deadline as block.timestamp + 600, making the deadline miner-manipulable.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] using raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom checks and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
list() overwrites balanceOf entries for arbitrary addresses supplied by the caller array.
constructor grants unlimited allowance[address(this)][uniRouter] and allowance[tx.origin][uniPair].
delegate() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
list() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
Only the caller matching owner can reach the delegatecall in delegate().
Only the caller matching owner can reach the liquidity listing logic.
delegate() forwards caller-supplied address and calldata into an unguarded delegatecall.
The checkBots modifier executes a low-level external call to protectionFromBots before the modified body.
list() invokes uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with msg.value and a timestamp-based deadline.
list() invokes protectionFromBots.call with an arbitrary address array and ignores the success flag.
transferFrom performs withdrawal of _value from allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom debits balanceOf[_from] by _value with unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom credits balanceOf[_to] by _value with unchecked addition.
transfer() delegates the entire transfer flow to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
The checkBots modifier performs an external call before transferFrom updates allowance and balances, allowing re-entrant transferFrom execution.
protectionFromBots is an external contract whose call gate can re-enter transferFrom from inside the modifier.
list() calls protectionFromBots before writing the batch of recipient balances, enabling re-entrancy into list or transferFrom.
pairForPancake computes and returns the value stored in uniPair.
The constructor assigns uniPair = pairForPancake(wBNB, address(this)).
The constructor consumes tx.origin both as owner and as allowance beneficiary.
The index i drives the balance-overwrite loop inside list().
Recipient addresses from _reallyGoHere are written directly into balanceOf.
Credit amounts from _amounts are written directly into balanceOf without any supply check.
The bool returned by the low-level call is decoded into notABot and used in the require.
